title: [review] coap_dtn.c zcbor API misuse: 3-arg tstr_decode + nonexistent map_end_force_decode = compile break
description: P0. parse_recipient at lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_dtn.c:40 calls zcbor_tstr_decode(zsd, &key, 1) — zcbor API is 2-arg (zcbor_decode.h:74: bool zcbor_tstr_decode(zcbor_state_t*, struct zcbor_string*)). Line 49 calls zcbor_map_end_force_decode(zsd) — nonexistent; real symbol is zcbor_list_map_end_force_decode (zcbor_decode.h:257). Any build with CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_DEADDROP=y fails to compile. Introduced in the 6mij.2.3/.2.4 handler migration; missed because verification was cppcheck-only (not a type-checker). Fix: 2-arg calls; then west build -b qemu_x86 an app with CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_DEADDROP=y (or extend lichen/tests/coap_keys-style ztest) to prove compilation.
close_reason: Verified: zcbor 2-arg tstr_decode + zcbor_list_map_end_force_decode already correct at HEAD (checked against zcbor_decode.h:74,257). Remaining break was -Werror=discarded-qualifiers at coap_dtn.c:86 (c47cbab5c3 removed const from s_provider but left the param const while writing s_provider->dtn_buf). Fixed: dropped const from lichen_coap_deaddrop_register param in .c + header (matches documented dtn_buf auto-set contract, no callers in repo). Proof: west build -b qemu_x86 with overlay-deaddrop-proof.conf + ZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES builds coap_dtn.c.obj clean; cppcheck clean; 3-perspective review no findings. Full app link still blocked by pre-existing coap_keys_cbor.c/checkin.c Werrors (tracked: 7ab7, pdwe, dyrj, te9p) - not deaddrop-related. Build dir lichen/tests/coap_keys/build-deaddrop-proof (gitignored).
